preconditions.expression: all(5 <= len(s) <= 25 for s in s1) and all(5 <= len(s) <= 25 for s in s2)
preconditions.description: All strings in s1 and s2 have lengths between 5 and 25 (inclusive).
s1 and s2 are non-empty lists with lengths up to 5000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for s2_str in s2 if any(s2_str == s1_str[:len(s2_str)] or s2_str == s1_str[-len(s2_str):] for s1_str in s1))
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of strings in s2 that are either a prefix or suffix of at least one string in s1.
